common.interactionError: Something went wrong and that didn't finish. Try again in a moment — if it keeps happening, send staff this reference: `{ref}`

apply.alreadyWhitelisted: You're already a member. To link or change your Minecraft account, try joining any of our servers and run `/link` with the code it shows you.
apply.mcHint: Your Java Edition username, not your Discord name.
apply.ageHint: You must be at least {minAge} to apply. Enter digits only, e.g. 21.
apply.experiencePlaceholder: What do you enjoy building/doing? How long have you played?
apply.experienceHint: A few sentences is plenty — what you like building or doing.
apply.whyLabel: Why do you want to join us?
apply.whyHint: Tell us what draws you to this community in particular.
apply.ageInvalid: "{age}" is not a valid age — enter digits only, e.g. 21.
apply.ageTooYoung: Sorry, {brand} is a {minAge}+ community and we can't accept applicants under that age. You're welcome to apply again once you meet the age requirement.
apply.mcInvalid: `{name}` is not a valid Minecraft username — 3 to 16 letters, numbers or underscores, nothing else.
apply.draftExpired: That draft has expired. Run `/apply` to start again.
apply.submitted: Your application has been submitted — thank you! The {brand} staff team will review it shortly.
apply.alreadyReviewed: Someone already reviewed this application {when} — nothing to do.
apply.pendingExists: You already have an application awaiting review, please wait for staff to get to it.
apply.cooldownActive: Your last application was declined. You can apply again {when}.
apply.roleWarn: Could not assign the member role — check that the bot has **Manage Roles**, that the bot's own role is **above** the member role in Server Settings → Roles, and that `memberRoleId` in config.json is correct.
apply.welcomeWarn: Could not post the welcome message (check welcomeChannelId).
apply.welcomeDescription:
You've been approved!

To get on the servers, try joining any of them: you'll be shown a link code, then run `/link <code>` here to link your Minecraft account and get whitelisted.

Check <#{serverInfoChannelId}> for server details.
apply.approveSuccess: Approved <@{discordId}> and gave them the member role. They get whitelisted once they link their account with `/link`.
apply.denyDmDescription: Thank you for your interest in **{brand}**. After review, your application wasn't approved at this time.
apply.denyDmClosing: You're welcome to apply again in the future.

review.pickFromList: Pick an application from the list the command offers.
review.postMissing: The post is gone — the answers went with it.

link.commandDescription: Link your Minecraft account with the code a server showed you (approved members only)
link.optionDescription: The 6-digit code shown when you tried to join one of our servers
link.needMember: You need to be an approved member to link an account. Use `/apply` first.
link.codeInvalid: `{code}` isn't a valid link code, or it has expired (codes last 5 minutes). Try joining a server again to get a fresh one.
link.tooManyTries: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try joining a server again for a fresh code.
link.alreadyLinked: That Minecraft account is already linked to another Discord account. If it's yours, please reach out to staff.
link.success: Linked to **{name}** and whitelisted on the network. You can join now.
link.hubUnreachable: Could not reach the hub to link your account: {error}

unlink.commandDescription: (Staff) Remove a member's link and de-whitelist them
unlink.success: Unlinked <@{discordId}> (was `{name}`) and removed from the network whitelist.
unlink.hubUnreachable: Could not reach the hub to update the whitelist: {error}

resetcooldown.commandDescription: (Staff) Clear a member's re-apply cooldown so they can apply again
resetcooldown.optionDescription: Discord member whose cooldown to reset
resetcooldown.pending: <@{discordId}> has an application still awaiting review — decide that first (nothing to reset).
resetcooldown.noCooldown: <@{discordId}> isn't on cooldown — nothing to reset.
resetcooldown.success: Cleared the re-apply cooldown for <@{discordId}>. They can submit `/apply` again now.

whois.commandDescription: (Staff) Look up a Discord <-> Minecraft link

serverinfo.commandDescription: Show servers, versions and install links
serverinfo.embedDescription: Connect with the Java Edition of Minecraft using the addresses below.
serverinfo.empty: No servers are published yet. An admin publishes one from the dashboard.

config.commandDescription: View and change every bot setting
config.panelHint: Pick a section below to change it. Every change saves straight away.
config.labelBrandIcon: Logo image URL (leave empty to clear)
config.invalidMinAge: Minimum age must be a whole number between 1 and 120.
config.invalidCooldown: The cooldown must be a whole number of days between 0 and 365.
config.invalidColor: The colour must be a 6-digit hex value, e.g. `#5865F2`.
